Name: Saloon Attic and Basement
Author: EmpressKimi
Description:
[center]🧋 [size=5][font=Impact][color=#8e7cc3]S[/color][color=#674ea7]u[/color][color=#9fc5e8]p[/color][color=#3c78d8]p[/color][color=#93c47d]o[/color][color=#6aa84f]r[/color][color=#ffe599]t[/color] [color=#f1c232]t[/color][color=#f6b26b]h[/color][color=#b45f06]e[/color] [color=#cc4125]C[/color][color=#85200c]r[/color][color=#b4a7d6]e[/color][color=#6fa8dc]a[/color][color=#6aa84f]t[/color][color=#f1c232]o[/color][color=#b45f06]r[/color] [/font][/size]🧋
I create this mod for free out of a passion for the Stardew Valley modding community. If you enjoy my mod and want to show some love, you can do so by buying me 🧋boba🧋or donating to me on Paypal.
Find the donate button in the donations tab
[/center]
[center][size=5]❣️[/size][/center]

[center][size=5][font=Impact][color=#ffffff]Description[/color][/font][/size]

[color=#ffffff][size=4][font=Arial]Adds an attic with 8 fully furnished rooms each with a personality of its own, and a mostly furnished basement with 2 empty rooms to the Stardrop Saloon. This is for modders whose NPCs don't have homes or just want their NPCs to have another option of living space.
For the attic rooms you can just pick a room and add your NPC. For the basement, I left 2 rooms empty so that you can pick a room and map patch your room design onto the map. 

[b]___________________________________________________________________[/b][/font][/size][/color]

[font=Impact][size=5]Message to 🍏[color=#a4c2f4]Modders[/color]🍎[/size][/font]

[size=4][font=Arial]If you have an NPC that you created and want to live in one of the rooms, but don't know how to do a map patch or how to get them into a room, just either send me a message or make a forum on the mod page and I will assist if I can. If you do know what you are doing, no need to reach out, unless you want to say Hi![/font][/size]



[size=5][font=Impact]Message to 🧑‍🌾[color=#93c47d]Farmers[/color]👩‍🌾[/font][/size]

[size=4]If you have an NPC that you want to live here, you should reach out to that NPC's mod author to get a hold of me and we can collaborate. You need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38116]PC's Tilesheet[/url] mod because I used their tilesheets to decorate some of the rooms in the basement.[/size][/center]
[center][size=4] I made the basement toggleable, you can turn off the basement in the config.json by entering 'false' or use a mod like GenericModConfigMenu to turn off the basement. Obviously, do not go inside the Saloon when you are about to turn off the basement or you might crash the game.[/size]

[b][size=4]___________________________________________________________________[/size][/b] [/center]

[center][size=5][font=Impact]Installation[/font][/size][size=3][font=Impact] [/font][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][color=#6aa84f][size=4]How to install:[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center]Unpack the .zip and put entire [CP] Saloon Attic & Basement into your Stardew Valley mod folder[/center]

[center][b][color=#f1c232][size=4]How to uninstall:[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center]Just delete the [CP] Saloon Attic & Basement folder from your Stardew Valley mod folder[/center]

[center][b][color=#e69138][size=4]How to update:[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center]Manually delete the [CP] Saloon Attic & Basement folder first from your Stardew Valley mod folder and then replace with new updated one[/center]

[center][/center]
[center][b][size=4]___________________________________________________________________[/size][/b][/center]

[center][size=5][b]⚔️[/b][font=Impact]Background[/font][b]⚔️[/b][/size]

[font=Arial]I made this mod so that my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6316]NPC Roronoa Zoro[/url] can have another place to live in case you don't want to have his boathouse in your game. The Saloon Attic & Basement mod is independent of where you want Zoro to live. This mod will still show up even if you want Zoro to live in his boathouse.

[b][size=4]___________________________________________________________________[/size][/b][/font][/center]

[center][color=#D4D4D8]As of June 2026 I have come back after 4 years of haitus. A lot has changed in the modding community! I used to have Zoro live at TrentXV's Boarding House BusStop Extension. It looks like the mod author has taken that mod down. I got motivated to create my own mod to house NPCs.[/color][/center]
